title: board.setup_flows: a module's guided setup, rendered by the board at #/setup/<module> (one flow per module). Compile adds `module` and, with a pair_url, `pair_token` (the name of the generated secret <module>_pair_token the board sends as bearer).

order.description: where it sits among the flows, lowest first

why.description: one sentence: what the person gets

effort.description: e.g. about 2 minutes, needs the Telegram app

secrets.description: names of this module's secrets with `setup:`, shown as paste fields in this order

signin.description: an id from this module's board.signins: its connect button
